scope: Focused acquisition pass for Lotfali Barqi's Akhtar edition of the Turkish Divan-i Haqiqi, separated from the general modern-edition source-apparatus pass.

target.title_persian: تورکجه حقیقی دیوانی: قاراقویونلو جهانشاه منسوب اولونموشدور
target.title_latin: Turkja Haqiqi Divani: Qaraqoyunlu Jahanshah mansub olunmushdur
target.author_attribution: Jahanshah b. Qara Yusuf Haqiqi Turkmen
target.why_priority: The public Telegram announcement says Barqi explicitly follows Minorsky's authorship doubt and offers a near-critical Arabic-script edition preserving linguistic features; the preface and source list are therefore high-value even if the edition adds no new manuscript witness.

sources_checked.observed: Confirms bibliographic metadata, ISBN, 156 pages, 200-copy print run, Akhtar publisher, Barqi as corrector/editor, and Jahanshah b. Qara Yusuf Haqiqi Turkmen as poet. The page itself says Mahdroo's shop is inactive and is only an information surface.
sources_checked.acquisition_value: Bibliographic authority and aggregator hints only; not a purchase route.

sources_checked.source: Turkish language and literature Telegram mirror
sources_checked.observed: Forwards Evdeal's original sale post for product 1365 and repeats the publisher announcement. The post gives price 42,000 toman, ISBN 1-342-486-600-978, Akhtar/Tabriz, 1399, 156 pages, and says Barqi's introduction addresses Minorsky's doubts about authorship.
sources_checked.acquisition_value: Best evidence for the original seller route and for why the edition matters.

sources_checked.observed: DNS resolves and TCP ports 80/443 connect, but HTTP and HTTPS requests timed out with no response during the 2026-05-18 pass. The Telegram source still gives @evdeal as the practical contact route.
sources_checked.acquisition_value: Likely original online seller, but current web route is unusable from this environment.

sources_checked.observed: Rendered page lists four PDF vendors: Fidibo, Taaghche, Ketabchin, and Ketabrah, with prices and update dates in Ordibehesht 1405. The rendered buttons are disabled/cursor-not-allowed and do not expose outbound links. Independent Taaghche searches by exact title and ISBN did not find the book, Fidibo returned 403, Ketabrah redirected to an error page for the attempted search URL, and Ketabchin timed out.
sources_checked.acquisition_value: Treat as stale or non-actionable until one provider is verified directly by search or login.

sources_checked.source: Mahdroo sample / Book House PDF redirect
sources_checked.observed: Clicking Mahdroo's sample link opened both the Mahdroo asset URL and a Book House / pic.ketab.ir sample PDF route with identifier 1400324250. The Book House route returned 403 and showed a 'site updating/forbidden' image in browser; shell download also returned 403.
sources_checked.acquisition_value: High-value retry target from a different network or authenticated Iranian access; may expose the table of contents or preface pages.

sources_checked.observed: Active publisher channel gives address 'Tabriz, first Taleghani Street, opposite Mosalla, Nashr-i Akhtar' and manager handle @Nashre_akhtar. Recent posts continue advertising Akhtar titles.
sources_checked.acquisition_value: Best direct acquisition route for a physical copy.

sources_checked.observed: Directory entry identifies manager Samad Mahdi Asilbi, activity as publishing/bookshop, email akhtar-pub@yahoo.com, and address in Tabriz at first Taleghani Street opposite Mosalla. Phone/mobile/fax are image-rendered in the directory.
An older Akhtar title announcement gives the same shop location and lists phone 04115555393. Other regional lists give the modernized equivalent 04135555393 for Akhtar Bookshop.
sources_checked.acquisition_value: Phone route worth trying, but treat as older contact data until confirmed.

sources_checked.observed: Rendered page lists Astan Quds Razavi Library in Mashhad as holding/loan surface, with last update 1405/02/17. The 'search in library' button was non-actionable in the browser session.
sources_checked.acquisition_value: Potential institutional consultation route if publisher/seller acquisition fails.

request_template_fa: سلام. برای یک پروژه پژوهشی درباره نسخه‌ها و چاپ‌های دیوان حقیقی، دنبال کتاب «تورکجه حقیقی دیوانی: قاراقویونلو جهانشاه منسوب اولونموشدور»، مقدمه و تصحیح لطفعلی برقی، نشر اختر تبریز، ۱۵۶ صفحه، شابک 978-600-486-342-1 هستم. آیا نسخه‌ای برای خرید موجود است؟ اگر ممکن است، برای تشخیص مأخذ تصحیح، تصویر/اسکن مقدمه، فهرست منابع یا نسخه‌های مورد استفاده، و صفحه اول و آخر متن را هم می‌خواهم. استفاده فقط پژوهشی و با ارجاع خواهد بود.
request_template_en: Hello. I am trying to acquire Lotfali Barqi's Akhtar edition 'Turkja Haqiqi Divani: Qaraqoyunlu Jahanshah mansub olunmushdur' (Tabriz: Nashr-i Akhtar, 156 pp., ISBN 978-600-486-342-1) for a research project on the manuscript and printed transmission of Divan-i Haqiqi. Is a copy available for purchase? If possible, I also need images/scans of the introduction, source/manuscript list, and the first and last text pages so that the edition's source basis can be cited accurately.
open_questions: Does Barqi cite specific manuscript shelfmarks, or is the edition based only on prior printed editions?
Does the introduction materially revise Minorsky's authorship caveat or only discuss it rhetorically?
Do the 156 pages include a bibliography/source list, notes, or only the edited text?
Is the Book House sample PDF accessible from an Iranian network or only through a disabled public route?
register_impact: No witness-register status change. This is an acquisition and source-apparatus target for a printed edition, not independent manuscript evidence.
